{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_values = sales_df['customer_age'].unique()

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Output sentinel values and mean age
sentinel_values, mean_age_converted"}
